cartouche.title: Cartouche 3D business card

index.title: The Studio
index.lead: Four objects designed by the workshop, limited so they print on our machines. Customise the shape, the colors and the text, check the numbers, then send it: the workshop reviews every request and replies within 48 hours with a firm price.

adjust.title: Customise
adjust.text: Shape, pattern, up to four colors, your text: the 3D view follows every move.

check.title: Check
check.text: Dimensions, grams, time and printability are really calculated, not guessed.

send.title: Send
send.text: Your customisation goes to the workshop with its print file. Nothing is paid at this stage.

receive.title: Receive
receive.text: The workshop reviews your piece and replies within 48 hours with a firm price, payable online.

printable.q: Is what I customise really printable?
printable.a: Every object is limited so that it prints on the workshop's machines (250 mm build plate, PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle). A badge says “Printable”, “Check needed” or “Not printable”, with the first issue in plain words and a “Fix it” button when a fix exists.

price.a: The firm price is confirmed by the workshop within 48 hours, after it reviews your piece. It depends on the material, the print time and the number of color changes. Nothing is charged before this confirmation.

text.a: Yes. A person at the workshop reads every text before printing. We refuse third-party brands, insults and unlawful content. Your text never appears in the page address or in the links you copy.

colors.a: With filament changes at set heights, up to four filaments: this is what the workshop sets up in its slicer. The colors shown are indicative, the final color depends on the spool in stock.

after.q: What happens after I send it?
after.a: The workshop checks your file and replies by e-mail within 48 hours with a firm price. You follow the request in your account, then pay online; the piece is printed and shipped within Switzerland.

custom.title: A file, a precise idea?
custom.text: For a piece that is not in the Studio, send your 3D file or describe your project: personalized quote within 48 hours.

lavaux.lead: Five profiles, five patterns, up to four colors through filament changes. Printed in standard mode, never as a spiral.

cartouche.lead: 85 × 55 mm, the Swiss format. Four layouts, embossed or engraved text, two colors.

relief.lead: A layered mountain range on 100 mm, from the lake to the snow. Your name on the summit, at a fictional altitude.

borne.lead: A text of 1 to 14 characters, four shapes, a ring if you want to hang it.
